subject.title: feat(plugins): add Computer Use provider contract

question: Should Computer Use provider identity be a permanent public runtime Plugin SDK contract in addition to the manifest ownership declaration, or should this change stop at manifest-first static discovery until a node-host consumer defines the runtime contract?
rationale: The decision controls a newly exported external API and the security-sensitive boundary between static plugin ownership and host permission or launch behavior; source review cannot safely choose that long-term product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve a minimal runtime descriptor
options.body: Accept `{ id, label }` as a stable public Plugin SDK contract and require the follow-up node-host consumer to preserve that boundary.

options.title: Keep this manifest-first
options.body: Land or narrow to static `contracts.computerUseProviders` discovery, then introduce runtime registration only with its first consumer and an approved lifecycle contract.

options.title: Adopt the overlapping host-metadata direction
options.body: Choose the related static host-binding metadata approach if macOS permission and transport discovery must be represented before runtime loads.

recommendation.title: Keep this manifest-first
recommendation.body: Land or narrow to static `contracts.computerUseProviders` discovery, then introduce runtime registration only with its first consumer and an approved lifecycle contract.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa has carried the current and prior manifest-contract designs and can provide the clearest technical context for the maintainer decision.
